appliedas.configuration.title: Applied Astralsorcery Configuration
appliedas.configuration.processing.toolt: Processing time in ticks. 20 ticks = 1 second. Changes apply to ongoing operations after saving.
Time per operation in both inventory and dropped-item modes. Default: 40 ticks (2 seconds).
appliedas.configuration.transmutationFoc: Transmutation time when using a focal point directly. Default: 1200 ticks (60 seconds).
appliedas.configuration.transmutationSta: Transmutation time with crystal or other transmitted starlight. Matching transmitted light takes priority over a local focal point. Default: 200 ticks (10 seconds).
appliedas.configuration.transmutationOve: Transmutation time after paying 5 Lm of Aion for overclocking. Default: 20 ticks (1 second). Insufficient lumen uses the current starlight source's time.
gui.appliedas.alchemy_array.network_offl: ME offline: combination production requires an online network. Stored lumen remains available to consumers. Native starlight consumption and catalyst wear still apply.
gui.appliedas.gateway.use_star: Use the gateway's stars to travel
gui.appliedas.gateway.requirements: Insert a Spatial Storage Cell. Every dimension must exceed 5 blocks. Unformatted cells are formatted automatically.
message.appliedas.gateway.inactive: Complete the gateway structure and meet its sky requirements first.
message.appliedas.gateway.size: Each spatial dimension must be greater than 5 blocks.
message.appliedas.gateway.formatting: The cell is still being formatted.
message.appliedas.gateway.invalid: This cell has no valid spatial plot. Insert an unformatted cell to format it.
message.appliedas.gateway.blocked: No safe portal landing is available. Leave clear space above a solid floor.
message.appliedas.gateway.no_return: This return portal has no available entrance.
gui.appliedas.chisel.mode.hint: Process materials in the item slots or nearby dropped items.
gui.appliedas.chisel.round_robin.hint:
On: switch dropped items after each operation.
Off: keep processing the same stack.
gui.appliedas.chisel.auto_input.hint:
Pull materials from containers beside input faces.
Pipes and hoppers can still insert items when off.
gui.appliedas.chisel.auto_output.hint:
Send products to containers beside output faces.
Pipes and hoppers can still extract items when off.
tooltip.appliedas.non_empty_annihilation: Leaves blocks with no drops intact. Otherwise behaves like an Annihilation Plane.
message.appliedas.altar.working: Altar job at %s, %s, %s — waiting for crafting conditions or completion
message.appliedas.altar.return_blocked: Output buffered — waiting for space in the pattern provider
gui.appliedas.wand.title: ME Resonating Wand
gui.appliedas.wand.items_detail: Off: take blocks from your inventory
gui.appliedas.wand.items_hint: When enabled, use ME building blocks first and fill any shortage from your inventory. When disabled, use only your inventory. Fluids and recovered blocks still use the linked ME network.
gui.appliedas.wand.fluids_hint: Fill missing infuser pools with Liquid Starlight from ME (1,000 mB per source). When disabled, leave the pools unchanged.
gui.appliedas.wand.replace_hint: Recover replaceable building blocks with silk-touch drops into ME. Stops if ME cannot accept them. Protected or unbreakable blocks, containers, machines and multi-block objects are skipped.
tooltip.appliedas.wand.bind: Link in a Wireless Access Point, or sneak-right-click it.
tooltip.appliedas.wand.configure: Right-click air to open the configuration screen.
message.appliedas.wand.missing_combined: Insufficient ME and inventory materials: %s (need %s in total).
message.appliedas.wand.recovery_full: ME cannot accept the replaced blocks. Construction stopped.
message.appliedas.wand.recovery_pending: Recovery interrupted. Remaining resources are retained in the wand.
message.appliedas.wand.linked: ME Resonating Wand linked to this network.
message.appliedas.wand.unlinked: Link the wand to a Wireless Access Point first.
message.appliedas.wand.unavailable: The linked access point is missing or unloaded.
message.appliedas.wand.out_of_range: No active Wireless Access Point from this network is in range.
message.appliedas.wand.no_power: The ME network has insufficient power to supply this structure.
message.appliedas.wand.missing: Insufficient ME materials: %s (need %s; fluid amounts are in mB).
message.appliedas.wand.blocked: Cannot build at %s, %s, %s. Clear obstacles and check building permissions.
message.appliedas.wand.invalid_fluid: This fluid cannot form a source block here.
message.appliedas.wand.interrupted: Construction interrupted. Unused materials are returned or retained in the wand.
guide.appliedas.liquid_starlight.source: Drop the ingredients into a Liquid Starlight source block.
guide.appliedas.liquid_starlight.form: Consumes the ingredients and liquid to form a new crystal cluster.
guide.appliedas.liquid_starlight.grow: Consumes the liquid for a chance to increase crystal size by 1.
guide.appliedas.liquid_starlight.merge: Consumes the liquid to merge the crystals, keeping some of their attributes.
gui.appliedas.array.network_offline: ME network offline: check power and channels
gui.appliedas.array.catalyst_marker_hint: Insert the indicated item, or enable automatic supply.
gui.appliedas.array.catalyst_missing: No catalyst recipe found for the selected lumen.
gui.appliedas.array.lumen_hint: %s / 4000 Lm. Gold marker: reserve of %s Lm.
gui.appliedas.array.filaments_hint: Allow ME Lumen Filaments to draw lumen.
gui.appliedas.array.supply_hint: Restock liquid starlight and catalysts from ME.
gui.appliedas.array.switch_hint: Waiting for old lumen and catalyst to return to ME.
gui.appliedas.chalice.network_offline: ME offline: check power, channels, and connections.
gui.appliedas.chalice.pull_hint: Refill from ME to the reserve amount.
gui.appliedas.chalice.fluid_hint: %s / 64000 mB. Gold marker: reserve of %s mB.
gui.appliedas.chalice.interaction_hint: Right-click with a fluid container to transfer; empty hand to configure.
gui.appliedas.chalice.filter_hint: Drop a fluid; right-click with a container to mark; click empty-handed to clear.
gui.appliedas.chalice.switch_hint: Waiting for the old fluid to drain.
gui.appliedas.transmutation.auto_pull_hi: Pull items from the ME network
gui.appliedas.transmutation.marker_hint: Left-click with an item to set or increase the amount; right-click to decrease. Left-click with an empty cursor to clear.
gui.appliedas.transmutation.marker_amoun: Middle-click to set amount; scroll ±1, Shift + scroll ±10.
gui.appliedas.array.redstone_hint: When enabled, production requires a redstone signal; when disabled, redstone is ignored.
